narrative.intro: Lumen Technologies Government Solutions has $91.3M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Lumen Technologies Government Solutions received 7 awards in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $13M. Obligations fell 74.3% year over year. Historical obligations show larger activity in prior years, including $160M in FY22, $352M in FY23, $280M in FY24, $423M in FY25, and $355M in FY26. The FY2027 totals are partial because the fiscal year is ongoing. The Department of Veterans Affairs accounts for the entire FY2027 obligation total at $91.3M. Smaller recorded buyers in FY2027 include the Railroad Retirement Board at $5.8K and several agencies with $0 obligations. These figures are contract obligations unless noted otherwise for award-value tables. This snapshot describes current-year obligations and the recent trend without inferring future performance or offering product-level detail beyond what the contract records disclose.

sections.heading: How have obligations trended year over year?
sections.body: Lumen Technologies Government Solutions obligations fell 74.3% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year were: FY22 $160M, FY23 $352M, FY24 $280M, FY25 $423M, FY26 $355M, and FY27 $91.3M. The FY2027 figure is fiscal year to date and is partial. The recent decline reflects the difference between FY26 and the current-year obligation total.

sections.heading: Which agencies are buying from Lumen Technologies Government Solutions this fiscal year?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs obligated $91.3M to Lumen Technologies Government Solutions in FY2027 to date. The Railroad Retirement Board obligated $5.8K. The Department of Agriculture, International Trade Commission, and Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation show $0 obligations in FY2027 to date.
